annotations.exact_quote: Specifically, we first exploit an auto-encoder to represent input data samples with latent features for the construction of an attribute matrix.
annotations.reason_zh: 使用可学习自编码器获取潜在特征并用于子空间聚类，满足基于可学习神经表示的数据划分。

annotations.exact_quote: Adaptive Attribute and Structure Subspace Clustering Network
annotations.reason_zh: 标题明确为子空间聚类网络，摘要进一步以自表达关系学习亲和图。

annotations.exact_quote: Then, we perform self-expressiveness on the constructed attribute and structure matrices to learn their affinity graphs separately.
annotations.reason_zh: 对属性/结构矩阵做自表达并分别学习亲和图，即学习样本间亲和矩阵/边结构。

annotations.exact_quote: In this paper, we propose a novel adaptive attribute and structure subspace clustering network (AASSC-Net) to simultaneously consider the attribute and structure information in an adaptive graph fusion manner.
annotations.reason_zh: 将属性信息与结构信息作为同一对象的两种互补表示，并通过自适应图融合联合利用。
